zh_CN.name: 深度回应

en.name: Natural replies
en.prompt:
{推文内容}

{关注状态}

Write 3 natural English replies to this X post.

Requirements:
- Sound like real X replies, not marketing copy or a formal article comment
- Each reply should make one clear point: agree, add context, ask a sharp question, or offer a mild counterpoint
- Avoid generic praise, outrage bait, personal attacks, and hashtags
- Keep each reply concise, roughly 8-28 words
- Output only ready-to-post reply text, each inside its own code block
- Use the follow status only to calibrate tone; never mention it in the reply

en.name: Sharp but fair
en.prompt:
{推文内容}

{关注状态}

Write 3 English replies to this X post with a sharper point of view.

Requirements:
- Be specific, thoughtful, and concise
- You may challenge assumptions, add a counterexample, or clarify the tradeoff
- Stay fair; no insults, no dunking, no culture-war bait
- Keep each reply around 12-35 words
- Output only ready-to-post reply text, each inside its own code block
- Use the follow status only to calibrate tone; never mention it in the reply

Requirements:

en.name: Point-by-point

{推文内容}

ja.name: 自然な返信
ja.prompt:
{推文内容}

{关注状态}

この X 投稿に対する自然な日本語返信を 3 件作成してください。

条件：
- 実際の X の返信らしく、宣伝文や記事コメントのようにしない
- 各返信は、共感・補足・軽い疑問・別視点のいずれかを 1 つだけ扱う
- 空っぽな称賛、過度な煽り、個人攻撃は避ける
- 1 件あたり 15〜45 字程度
- そのまま投稿できる本文だけを、各返信ごとにコードブロックで出力する
- フォロー状態は距離感の判断にだけ使い、返信本文には書かない
